_comment: BOOK OVERLAYS round 2 (bases with ≥2 live trades, 105): __inv inverted imbalance, __bx book-flip exit, __bbe BE on flip, __btp take-profit into pressure, __sz size on agreement, __wait fill timing. BOOK OVERLAYS: 716 sibling variants (<base>__sg spread gate 1.5x rolling, __imb bid-share 0.55, __micro microprice lead, __all) of 179 bases — never edit a base, compare via base_id/overlay; + 10 book_imbalance family. ACCOUNT ENVELOPE OFF (daily_loss_limit/trailing_drawdown_cap = 0): 197 strategies x 1 MNQ on one $25k envelope is not an account, and a $1k trailing cap halted the whole research fleet on 2026-09-22 after a +3.1k/-2.6k day. Risk unit = per-strategy strategy_daily_loss_limit. Paper fleet across ALL sessions (Asia 20:00–02:30, London 02:30–07:30, US pre-market, RTH, US evening, whole Globex day): 113 trend-engine variants (22 modes: trend, failed-breakout, Keltner, Ichimoku, ROC, delta, fib, mean-reversion VWAP/band/RSI2, htf gate, chandelier) + 57 ORB variants (09:30 range sweep + other session times/timeframes + entry/management rules) + 25 MTF scalpers (HTF choices, trigger modes, sessions, direction) on one tradeify paper account. Base params = config/tradeify_config.json; per-strategy params override named OrbConfig/MtfScalperConfig fields. Consumed by paper_engine (ticks from PostgreSQL, no Rithmic session). feed_symbol = what the collector writes (NQ front-month); symbol = traded label (MNQ). reference_symbol (ES) feeds the MTF SMT/intermarket module as 1m bars.
